svg.title: The diff gate: nova diff A B and its exit codes
svg.desc: How nova diff compares two runs and how its exit code gates CI. A ref that does not resolve exits 2. Malformed record lines are skipped and counted. Only logical model calls are aligned. Under --assert-no-regressions an incomplete read exits 2, any difference exits 1, and otherwise the gate exits 0. Step 1: nova diff takes two capsule paths or run IDs; a ref that does not resolve exits 2 before anything is compared. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 2: A record line that is not UTF-8, not JSON or not a JSON object is skipped, counted per side and warned about on stderr. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 3: Only logical model calls are aligned: wire records marked transport are left out, so one SDK call is one pair (ADR-0305). (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 4: Environment, model calls, tool calls and outputs/ are compared; a provider change under the same model is a changed call. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 5: One property, has_changes, is the verdict; text, json and github-annotation all read it, so an added-only diff is an error. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 6: With --assert-no-regressions an incomplete read is checked first: the runs were not fully compared, so the gate exits 2. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 7: Then has_changes decides: exit 1 for any difference, else 0. Without a gate flag, a difference is reported and exits 0. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).)

nova diff takes two capsule paths or run IDs; a ref that does not resolve exits 2 before anything is compared.
A record line that is not UTF-8, not JSON or not a JSON object is skipped, counted per side and warned about on stderr.
Only logical model calls are aligned: wire records marked transport are left out, so one SDK call is one pair (ADR-0305).
Environment, model calls, tool calls and outputs/ are compared; a provider change under the same model is a changed call.
One property, has_changes, is the verdict; text, json and github-annotation all read it, so an added-only diff is an error.
With --assert-no-regressions an incomplete read is checked first: the runs were not fully compared, so the gate exits 2.
Then has_changes decides: exit 1 for any difference, else 0. Without a gate flag, a difference is reported and exits 0.
